sampled_retention.interpretation: Matched known-scene observations from one inherited initialization; historical control episodes are reused, not newly executed or independent generalization trials.
sampled_retention.baseline_origin: Verified attempt-016 baseline, reused without new training or episodes.

main_simulator_accounting.semantics: New policy actions and copied-simulator reset certification are distinct. Historical certification counts were not logged and are not invented as zeros or new work.

paired_dense_rankings.interpretation: Improvements and regressions refer to demonstration-action rankings on matched reference inputs, not inferred physical successes or failures.

first_update_objective_comparison.scope: The first objective differs only in its TD coefficient. Later states, Adam moments and Bellman targets evolve on separate trajectories.

limitations: Only the mean TD Huber coefficient changes from one to one half; all supervised coefficients remain one and MC is inactive.
The control's 8000 updates and 87 episodes are historical reused evidence, not new attempt-019 computation.
Actual demonstration-return RMSE is measured only, not optimized or assumed to represent optimal Q values.
Reset-time certification uses simulator copies and is reported separately from policy actions; unavailable historical certification counts remain unknown.
Dense reference-state rank changes do not imply measured episode failure, particularly after a trajectory leaves the shared prefix.
Three known scenes and one initialization do not establish held-out generalization or online learning.
This analyzer performs no environment reset, environment step, optimizer update or forced-action rescue.
